async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
				await Promise.all([
					// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
					await operation(items[index]),
					// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
					await audit(items[index]),
				]);
			}
		}),
	);
}
async function wrapped(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
				await store(
					// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
					await operation(items[index]),
					// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
					await audit(items[index]),
				);
			}
		}),
	);
}
